{{- /* The reading order of the documentation: each section of the "docs" menu, then its pages by weight. Returns a slice of pages. */ -}} {{- $pages := slice }} {{- range site.Menus.docs }} {{- with .Page }} {{- $pages = $pages | append . }} {{- range .Pages.ByWeight }} {{- $pages = $pages | append . }} {{- end }} {{- end }} {{- end }} {{- return $pages }}
